test_cases.check_title: Endpoint rejects requests with no credentials
Requesting another user's object ID returns 403/404, not the object
test_cases.expected: 403 Forbidden when Bob's token requests Alice's order (owner_id=1)
test_cases.evidence: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer bob-token' http://127.0.0.1:8765/orders/1 -> HTTP/1.0 200, body includes owner_id=1 while caller is user_id=2

test_cases.check_title: Low-privilege account cannot call admin/staff-only endpoints
test_cases.actual: 200 OK, admin stats returned to a 'user' role token

test_cases.check_title: CORS does not reflect arbitrary Origin with credentials allowed
test_cases.expected: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin reflection for an arbitrary Origin
test_cases.actual: Demo API sends no CORS headers at all (not applicable for this lab's minimal server)
test_cases.evidence: demo_api.py has no CORS handling code path
